newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Forbo 1996 profit falls on charges.
newsitem.headline: Forbo 1996 profit falls on charges.

text.p: Forbo Holding AG said its net income in 1996 fell to 31.0 million Swiss francs from 1995's 55.6 million due to special provisions of 30 million.
Forbo also said in a statement that is board of directors had approved paying an unchanged dividend of 19 francs per share on 1996 results.
The dividend will be proposed to shareholders at their annual meeting on April 22.
In January Forbo had said that it would pay a steady dividend, but that its 1996 profit was expected to remain steady from 1995.
Forbo, a leading producer of floor and wall covering products, also said cash flow in 1996 rose to 170 million from 160 million.
Gross turnover rose a slight one percent in 1996 to 1.918 billion.
Before the special charges, which are linked to already announced divestment of non-core activities, Forbo's profit was 61.0 million, up from 1995's 55.6 million, the company said.
